name: Step Forward Step-Up

rehabilitation.clinical_protocol: Cornell Health Lower Extremity Strengthening Protocol

steps: Stand facing a sturdy low step or platform (4 to 8 inches high) with feet hip-width apart.
Place your entire right foot firmly onto the step.
Press down through your right heel to lift your body up, bringing your left foot onto the step beside your right.
Step backward with your left foot to the floor, followed by your right foot.
Repeat the movement leading with your left foot.
coaching_cues: Do not push off with your trailing back foot; make the lead leg do the work of lifting your body.
Keep your torso upright with your chest proud and eyes forward.
Ensure your whole foot is planted securely on the step before pressing up.

sources.attribution: Cornell Health Lower Extremity Strengthening Protocol
